Pakistan's Return to the Bay of Bengal Sparks Concern

The possibility of Pakistan returning to the Bay of Bengal, a region it last occupied 55 years ago, has raised concerns in India. The Indian Navy is reportedly preparing for a potential response. China's recent acquisition of a new 'Huangye' submarine has added fuel to speculation about Pakistan's intentions.
